descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S13 「真手机口述：流量里只有临时 token，绝没有密钥，也没有设备语音服务」 Real phone dictation: traffic shows an ephemeral token only, never a key, and no device speech service

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3a Speech-to-text runs through a BAA-covered, authenticated path, not a direct, unauthenticated call: routed server-side, with no API key in the browser.（UAT OAT-05 step 3；TFA-94423 AC 1）
  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And …（UAT OAT-05 step 1；TFA-94700 AC 5；TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1')；TFA-94423 AC 1）

测试设计方法：设备（device） — 在手机尺寸或真机（iPhone / Pixel）上看布局和手势。

Given The TestFlight build on an iPhone and the Play internal build on an Android phone, built against a named non-review deployment (the local stack over LAN or a UAT deployment, never , the store-review backend). …

When Dictate into the Hospital pre-round notes and the Nursing Home encounter. Then drop Wi-Fi mid-dictation and restore it, so the kept recording is recovered. Then, on one phone with automatic time off, set the clock 5 minutes fast and dictate once, set it 1 day back and dictate once, and restore the correct time (3.8).

Then HTTP(S): before each live session the device calls the Convex prepareSession action. The only OpenAI HTTP(S) request is POST /v1/realtime/calls, with an ephemeral client secret (as minted by prepareSession), never a long-lived sk- key. The recovered recording uploads to Convex, not to OpenAI. …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 3 and step 1 on iOS and Android, and UAT 3.8 (server time, not device time). A long-lived key in any header, any speech HTTP(S) request that does not go to OpenAI or Convex, recovery audio sent straight to OpenAI, or a wrong-clock phone that cannot dictate or loses the dictation is a Fail, quoted with the host, step and clock offset. …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S13 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：DEVICE · 真机（iOS / Android）；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 dev 跑；来源：dev。
